name: Fabrica Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Fabrica Communications Co., Ltd. develops and markets systems for the used vehicle aftermarket. Its core product, symphony, is an integrated platform for the used car industry with customer and sales management, inventory-linked advertising, a B2B marketplace, export support, groupware, and financing and extended warranty services for vehicles. It also provides corporate SMS distribution. Dating from 1994, it has its headquarters in Nagoya, Japan.
